name: Editor Tools
description: Free editor helpers: Scatter Brush, Polygon/Shape, Lasso Fill and Screenshot.

menu-x.name: Menu X
menu-x.description: Horizontal position of the tool buttons (in editor units, 0 = left edge).

menu-y.name: Menu Y
menu-y.description: Vertical position of the first tool button (in editor units, 0 = bottom edge).

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Action
max-objects.description: Safety limit: a single action never creates more objects than this. The Art Agent simplifies itself automatically to fit.

scatter-radius.name: Scatter: Radius
scatter-radius.description: Radius of the spray around your finger/cursor (editor units, 30 = one block).

scatter-count.name: Scatter: Objects Per Spray
scatter-count.description: How many objects are placed each time the brush sprays.

scatter-spacing.name: Scatter: Spacing
scatter-spacing.description: Distance you have to drag before the brush sprays again (editor units).

scatter-rotate.name: Scatter: Random Rotation
scatter-rotate.description: Give each sprayed object a random rotation.

polygon-mode.name: Polygon: Mode
polygon-mode.description: Outline = only the edges. Filled = edges + fill the inside.

polygon-thickness.name: Polygon: Line Thickness
polygon-thickness.description: Thickness of the outline (editor units, 30 = one block).

polygon-smoothing.name: Polygon: Corner Rounding
polygon-smoothing.description: 0 = sharp corners. 1-3 = progressively rounder corners (more objects).

fill-step.name: Fill: Cell Size
fill-step.description: Size of each filling block (editor units). 30 = full block. Smaller = finer fill but many more objects.

art-backend.name: Art AI: Service
art-backend.description: Cloudflare FLUX = best free image generator (needs a free Cloudflare account). Gemini / OpenAI-compatible (Groq, OpenRouter...) = a language model draws vector shapes. Pollinations = very limited now.

art-cf-account.name: Art AI: Cloudflare Account ID
art-cf-account.description: Cloudflare dashboard > AI > Workers AI > Use REST API > Get Account ID. Free, no card.

art-cf-token.name: Art AI: Cloudflare API Token
art-cf-token.description: Same page: Create a Workers AI API Token. About 100-170 free images per day. Stays on your computer.

art-plan.name: Art AI: Plan Prompt With AI
art-plan.description: Before drawing, a language model reads your selection's shape and writes a detailed brief (needs a Gemini or OpenAI-compatible key). Better results.

art-style.name: Art AI: Style
art-style.description: Realistic = detailed materials, lighting and shadows, front view (best for buildings and walls). Flat = simple bold shapes.

art-gemini-key.name: Art AI: Gemini API Key
art-gemini-key.description: Only needed for the Gemini backend. Free key from aistudio.google.com. Stays on your computer.

art-gemini-model.name: Art AI: Gemini Model
art-gemini-model.description: Model name used with Gemini. Change it if Google renames or retires this one.

art-openai-url.name: Art AI: Service URL
art-openai-url.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible service. Groq: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 - OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 - Cerebras: https://api.cerebras.ai/v1

art-openai-key.name: Art AI: Service API Key
art-openai-key.description: Your free API key for that service. Stays on your computer.

art-openai-model.name: Art AI: Service Model
art-openai-model.description: Model name. Groq: openai/gpt-oss-120b - OpenRouter: pick one ending in :free. Bigger models draw better.

art-mode.name: Art AI: Mode
art-mode.description: Smart blocks = the picture is traced into merged blocks inside your selection's shape (best). Shapes as real blocks = the model's vector shapes (Gemini/OpenAI only). Recolor = selected blocks just get colors.

art-colors.name: Art AI: Number of Colors
art-colors.description: How many color channels the art uses. More colors = more realistic shading but more blocks. Realistic art looks best with 12-20.

art-first-channel.name: Art AI: First Color Channel
art-first-channel.description: The art uses this channel and the next ones. Pick a range you are not using in your level (1-999).

art-cell.name: Art AI: Cell Size
art-cell.description: Detail of the art in editor units (30 = one block). Smaller = more detail but more blocks.

art-clip.name: Art AI: Stay Inside Selection Shape
art-clip.description: On = the art only covers the blocks you selected. Off = it fills the whole rectangle around them.

art-overhang.name: Art AI: Overhang
art-overhang.description: How far the art may extend past the edges of the selection (editor units). Useful for grass or snow on top.

art-smooth.name: Art AI: Cleanup
art-smooth.description: Removes speckle so the art uses fewer, bigger blocks. 0 = off, 1 = light, 2 = medium, 3 = strong.

screenshot-key.name: Screenshot Key
screenshot-key.description: Desktop key that saves a screenshot of the level (without the editor UI). On mobile use the Shot button.
